question: Which of the following places is NOT associated with Jainism?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kushinagar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Jainism is one of the world’s oldest living religions.
 
• Jainism grounds itself in 24 Tirthankaras.
 
• A ‘Tirthankara’, is the one who revealed religious truth at different times.
 
• The first Tirthankara was Rishabhadev.
 
• The last and 24th tirthankara of the Jainas was Mahaveer Swami or Vardhamana Mahavira.
 
• Jainism gained prominence under the aegis of Mahavira, during the sixth century BC.
 
• He was a kshatriya prince of the Lichchhavis, a group that was part of the Vajji sangha.
 
• At the age of thirty, he left home and went to live in a forest.
 
• For twelve years he led a hard and lonely life, at the end of which he attained enlightenment.
 
• The followers of Mahavira were known as Jainas.
 
• The teachings of Mahavira and his followers were transmitted orally for several centuries.
 
• 
 
They were written down in the form in which they are presently available at a place called Valabhi, in Gujarat, about 1500 years ago.

 

Mahaveer Swami__ was the last Teerthankar of Jainism.
